doctrine.name: Start at the first eligible visit
doctrine.thesis: The doctors on this brief already accept the science. They still wait. They start something familiar first, then the eligible moment has gone. Cost does the rest. So this is not a better-molecule story for CardioShield. It is a delay we have to retire, using only papers we can number. Lead the campaign with first-eligible / in-hospital initiation. PIONEER-HF (2019) shows that starting after haemodynamic stabilisation is feasible; ESC/ACC Class I plus PARADIGM-HF are the outcome permission — not a reason to wait for a second clinic visit.
doctrine.enemy: The habit of waiting until the patient is 'stable' in clinic
doctrine.bet: Start CardioShield at the first eligible encounter — in hospital if that is when they are eligible.
doctrine.whyNovel: Most launch decks sell the drug again. This one spends against the wait. If we cannot number the paper that allows a line, the line does not ship.

interventions.name: First-Touch Protocol
interventions.promise: A hospital-to-clinic initiation bundle so CardioShield is started at the first eligible encounter.
interventions.mlr: Protocol language must match label and local code. No start-all implication.
interventions.kill: If discharge initiation rate is unchanged at week 8 in the pilot site.

interventions.name: Affordability Confidence Kit
interventions.promise: A field-legal script, PAP mechanics, and HE one-pager that lets the HCP stay on the patient's side.
interventions.segment: Tier-2 consultants and high OOP caseloads
interventions.mlr: No price promises. Assistance, not inducement.
interventions.kill: If PAP mention rate rises but initiation does not.

interventions.name: Myth-Reset Asset
interventions.promise: One wrong belief, one local number, one peer voice. Unlearning, not a lecture.
interventions.mlr: Comparative safety claims need the source grade on-slide.
interventions.kill: If unaided myth prevalence does not drop in the next insight wave.

interventions.name: Peer Cascade
interventions.promise: Metro KOLs author the protocol; tier-2 peers demonstrate it. Cover travels down, not out as a TV ad.
interventions.kill: If cascade stops at the same five names by Q2.

interventions.name: Habit-Lock CRM
interventions.promise: The second prescription is designed, not hoped for. Prompts, feedback, peer norms.
interventions.mlr: CRM content is promotional and goes through MLR.
interventions.kill: If repeat rate among trialists is flat vs control geographies.

campaignLead.statement: Lead the campaign with first-eligible / in-hospital initiation. PIONEER-HF (2019) shows that starting after haemodynamic stabilisation is feasible; ESC/ACC Class I plus PARADIGM-HF are the outcome permission — not a reason to wait for a second clinic visit.
campaignLead.why: Highest-leverage validated row is PIONEER-HF 2019 (N Engl J Med 2019; PMID 30415601).
